| `price`                                   | Price in quoteMint (usually SOL) including this transaction’s impact.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `marketCapQuote`                          | Market capitalization in Quote token (usually Solana, USDC, USDT)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `pool`                                    | Liquidity source. Before migration, the value is either `pump` or `raydium-launchpad`. After migration, `pump` → `pump-amm`, `raydium-launchpad` → `raydium-cpmm`, `meteora-launchpad` → `meteora-damm-v1`/ `meteora-damm-v2`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| minPrice                                  | Available only in Meteora DAMM V2. Indicates the minimum price configured for the pool.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| maxPrice                                  | Available only in Meteora DAMM V2. Indicates the maximum price configured for the pool.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| curveType                                 | Present only in Meteora DAMM V1. Indicates the formula used for price calculation. Can be `constantProduct` (the most common one, based on the quote-reserve/base-reserve ratio) or `StableSwap` (ideal for stablecoin-to-stablecoin pools, keeping the price close to 1:1 even when reserves differ).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `binStep`                                 | Present only in Meteora DLMM. The price step between adjacent bins, in basis points (e.g. `400` means each bin is 4% apart, `1` means 0.01%). In DLMM liquidity is not spread along a curve — it sits in discrete price bins, and only the bins near the current price are tradable at any moment. A larger `binStep` means coarser price granularity and a wider spread. Important: unlike constant-product pools, `tokensInPool` and `quoteInPool` here are the **totals across all bins**, so a DLMM pool can show large reserves while still giving heavy slippage on a small trade — the liquidity may sit in bins far from the current price.                                                                                                 |
| poolFeeRate                               | Indicates the current fee rate in the pool. Can range from 0 to 1, where 0.1 represents 10% and 0.001 represents 1%.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `poolCreatedBy`                           | indicates who created the pool on pump-amm, raydium-cpmm, meteora-damm-v1, or meteora-damm-v2. If the pool was created by migration, the value is `pump`, `raydium-launchpad`, or `meteora-launchpad`. Pools migrated from pump and raydium-launchpad are considered trusted, but pools migrated from meteora-launchpad can be risky because Meteora allows config creators to choose how much liquidity share the pool creator receives after migration. Always check `lockedLiquidityAfterMigration` before relying on such pools. If the pool was created manually, the value is `custom`. Be cautious with these pools as well.                                                                                                                 |
| `lockedLiquidityAfterMigration`           | Present in Meteora Launchpad trades, and in `createConfig` events for both Meteora and Raydium Launchpad. Shows what percent of LP is locked forever after migration. In Meteora Launchpad, beware: the rest can be withdrawn right after migration (rug pull). In Raydium Launchpad there is no such risk: this part is locked in Burn & Earn, so the owner earns its fees but can never withdraw the liquidity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `poolFeeRateAfterMigration`               | Present only in Meteora Launchpad. Indicates what the poolFeeRate will be after migration. Meteora Launchpad allows values up to 0.1 (10%)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `platformAdmin`                           | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. The address that owns this config and can change it later.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `platformName`                            | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. The platform name, for example `stonkfun`. Don't trust it - anyone can put any name in there                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `platformWebsite`                         | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. The platform website. Can be empty.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `platformImage`                           | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. Link to the platform logo. Can be empty.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `platformFeeAddress`                      | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad & Meteora Launchpad. The address that receives the platform fee from every trade.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `platformNftAddress`                      | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. After migration the locked LP is sent here as a Fee Key NFT. The owner of this address earns the fees from that liquidity forever.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `platformVestingAddress`                  | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. The address that receives the platform's vested tokens. `None` means not used.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `platformFeeRate`                         | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. The platform fee on every trade, for example `0.01` = 1%.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `creatorFeeRate`                          | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. The token creator fee on every trade.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `platformVestingRate`                     | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. How much of each token's locked supply goes to the platform.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `restrictGlobalConfig`                    | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. `True` means token creators can only use the global configs this platform allows. Global configs are created by Raydium itself and set the quote token, the curve type and the base trade fee — nobody else can create one, so this flag only limits the choice.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `restrictCurveParam`                      | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. `True` means the token creator cannot freely choose the bonding curve settings.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `transferFeeAuthority`                    | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. For `spl-token-2022` tokens with a transfer fee: who can change that fee later. `None` means nobody.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `cpmmConfig`                              | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. The Raydium CPMM config the pool will use after migration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `poolCreatorAfterMigration`               | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. Who becomes the creator of the CPMM pool and earns the creator fee. `None` means the token creator.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `burnedLiquidityAfterMigration`           | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad only. What percent of LP is burned forever after migration — nobody earns fees from it. On Raydium Launchpad no liquidity can be withdrawn after migration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `migratesTo`                              | Present only in `createConfig` events. Raydium Launchpad & Meteora Launchpad. Where tokens from this config go after migration: `raydium-cpmm` or `meteora-damm-v1` or `meteora-damm-v2`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `leftoverReceiver`                        | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The address that receives all unsold tokens after migration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `leftoverTokens`                          | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How many tokens are left over and sent to `leftoverReceiver`. A big number means most of the supply goes to one address instead of the market. `None` when `fixedSupply` is `False`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `minPoolFeeRate`                          | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The lowest fee the pool will ever reach. If it equals `poolFeeRate`, the fee never changes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `feeScheduleDuration`                     | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How long it takes for `poolFeeRate` to drop to `minPoolFeeRate`. `0` means the fee is fixed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `feeScheduleUnit`                         | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The unit of `feeScheduleDuration` — `slot` (~200ms) or `second`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `baseFeeMode`                             | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How the fee goes down over time: `fixed` (never changes), `linear`, `exponential`, or `rateLimiter` (a very high fee for the first seconds, used against snipers).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `firstSwapWithMinFee`                     | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. `True` means the creator can make the first buy at `minPoolFeeRate`, skipping the high anti-sniper fee.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `dynamicFeeEnabled`                       | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. `True` means the fee also grows when the price moves fast.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `feeCollectedIn`                          | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The token the fee is taken in: `quote`, or `output` (the token you receive).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `creatorFeeShare`                         | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How much of the trading fee goes to the token creator, for example `'50%'`. The rest goes to the platform.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `poolCreationFee`                         | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How much SOL the token creator pays to launch a token with this config.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `transferFeeConfig`                       | Inside `tokenExtensions`. Present only for `spl-token-2022` tokens with a transfer fee. The token itself takes this fee on every transfer, including buys and sells: when you buy, you receive fewer tokens; when you sell, fewer tokens reach the pool. Contains the fields below.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `feeRate`                                 | Inside `tokenExtensions.transferFeeConfig`. The current transfer fee, for example `0.05` = 5%.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `maximumFee`                              | Inside `tokenExtensions.transferFeeConfig`. The max fee for one transfer, in tokens. The fee is `amount × feeRate`, but never more than this value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `nextFeeRate`                             | Inside `tokenExtensions.transferFeeConfig`. Present only if the fee will change in ≤ 2 epochs (~2 days). The new fee rate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `nextMaximumFee`                          | Inside `tokenExtensions.transferFeeConfig`. Present only if the fee will change in ≤ 2 epochs (~2 days). The new max fee.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `nextFeeFromBlock`                        | Inside `tokenExtensions.transferFeeConfig`. Present only if the fee will change in ≤ 2 epochs (~2 days). The block from which the new fee starts. Compare it with `block`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `decimals`                                | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How many decimal places tokens from this config will have.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `metadataAuthority`                       | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. Who can change the token name, symbol and image later: `creator`, `platform`, or `None` (nobody).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `mintAuthorityRetained`                   | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. `True` means the address in `metadataAuthority` can also mint more tokens.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `transferHookProgram`                     | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. An address means tokens will be `spl-token-2022` with a transfer hook: every transfer calls that program, and it can block your sell. Be careful. `None` for normal configs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `fixedSupply`                             | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. `True` means the supply is set in the config, so you know it before the token exists. `False` means the supply comes later, in the `create` event.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `supplyAfterMigration`                    | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The total supply after migration. `None` when `fixedSupply` is `False`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `tokensSoldBeforeMigration`               | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How many tokens are for sale on the bonding curve.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `tokensInPoolAfterMigration`              | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How many tokens go into the pool after migration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `creatorVestingTokens`                    | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How many tokens are locked for the creator after migration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `creatorVestingDuration`                  | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How long those tokens stay locked, in `feeScheduleUnit` units. `0` means no lock.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `initialPrice`                            | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The token price at the start of the bonding curve.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `migrationPrice`                          | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The token price at migration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `migrationFee`                            | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. What percent of the collected quote goes to the platform and creator instead of into the pool.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `creatorMigrationFeeShare`                | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The creator's share of `migrationFee`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `platformUnlockedLiquidityAfterMigration` | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. What percent of LP the platform can withdraw right after migration. A high value is risky.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `creatorUnlockedLiquidityAfterMigration`  | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. What percent of LP the creator can withdraw right after migration. A high value is risky.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `vestedLiquidityAfterMigration`           | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. What percent of LP unlocks slowly over time.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `liquidityVestingDuration`                | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. How long the vested liquidity stays locked, in `feeScheduleUnit` units.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `platformLockedLiquidityAfterMigration`   | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The platform's part of the locked liquidity. This liquidity stays in the pool forever — the platform only earns trading fees from it and can never withdraw it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `creatorLockedLiquidityAfterMigration`    | Present only in `createConfig` events. Meteora Launchpad only. The creator's part of the locked liquidity. This liquidity stays in the pool forever — the platform only earns trading fees from it and can never withdraw it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `migrationThresholds`                     | Present only in Meteora Launchpad and Raydium Launchpad. Indicates the required `quoteInPool` or `tokensInPool` value for a migration to occur. Pump.fun always uses a fixed requirement of ~85 SOL , or once `tokensInPool` reaches 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `burnedLiquidity`                         | shows what percent of liquidity is burned (for example, `"99%"`). Liquidity means someone adds Solana (or another quote token) and tokens into the pool. Normally, liquidity providers earn fees from trades and can withdraw their share at any time. If one person owns 100% of the liquidity, they can withdraw 100% and drain the pool, even after others buy the token. Pools with 0% burned liquidity are very risky because the owner can rug pull, and you will not be able to sell the token. Launchpads like pump.fun and partly raydium-launchpad burn the right to withdraw liquidity after migration. So if a pool has 20–30% or more burned liquidity, it is a good sign, because this part will always stay in the pool for trading. |
| `cashbackEnabled`                         | Deprecated since September 2026, replaced by `holderRewardsRate`. Indicates whether you are accumulating cashback for trading in this pool. Only older pump.fun and PumpSwap pools that haven't switched to the new format still accrue cashback; newer pools distribute rewards to holders instead. To claim your accumulated cashback, call [claimCashback](/claim-cashback.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `creatorFeeAddress`                       | It shows the address that receives the creator fees on pump.fun and pumpSwap if `cashbackEnabled` is `False`. Important: this address can change, since the real token creator has the right to modify it. Often, this address is the same as the one that originally created the token. The value may be `None` because not all pools have creator fees enabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `holderRewardsRate`                       | Present only in `pump` and `pump-amm` pools. Shows the percentage the token creator has set aside for distribution to token holders (up to 3%). Rewards are paid out every few hours in the `quoteMint` of the token's canonical pool. Keep in mind: when you buy in such a pool, you pay this percentage as an additional fee. Currently supported only for pump.fun tokens where `quoteMint` is not SOL or USDC.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `feeMint`                                 | Present only for `distributeFees` events. Shows the token in which the fees were distributed. For `pump.fun`, this is always `sol` or mint address. For `pump-amm`, this is usually `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112` (WSOL), but can be another token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `feeAmount`                               | Present only for `distributeFees` events. Shows the amount of accumulated fees that were distributed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `mayhemMode`                              | Indicates whether “mayhem mode” is active for `pump` or `pump-amm` pools. `true` means mayhem mode is on, `false` means it’s off. (Other pool types don’t have this field.). Usually, you should avoid `mayhemMode` == `True`, because this means that pump.fun’s AI agent receives 1 billion tokens. If it sells before you, you will no longer be able to sell and may encounter a 6024 Overflow error. In such a case, try to sell as much as you can, then call our burn method with 100% to burn all remaining tokens and receive a rent fee refund (0.002 SOL).                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `launchpadConfig`                         | The address where the settings for the Meteora or Raydium launchpad are stored. Anyone can create their own config on these launchpad.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `breakdown`                               | The same event split into individual trades, without aggregation. One transaction can contain several trades in the same pool (for example a bundle, where many wallets buy in one transaction). Top-level `tokenAmount` and `quoteAmount` are the sum of all of them, and `breakdown` shows each one separately: `action`, `trader`, `tokenAmount`, `quoteAmount`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `mintAuthority`                           | Address that has permission to mint new tokens. This **must always be `None`** — otherwise it’s a red flag for a potential *scam*. Only stablecoins usually have a non-`None` value. [More info](/tutorials/detect_scam_tokens.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `freezeAuthority`                         | Address that can freeze token accounts. This **must always be `None`** — a non-`None` value can indicate a *honeypot* or *scam*. Only stablecoins may have this set for regulatory reasons. [More info](/tutorials/detect_scam_tokens.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `tokenProgram`                            | Token program used to create the token — either `spl-token` (legacy) or `spl-token-2022` (newer standard). [More info](/tutorials/detect_scam_tokens.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `tokenExtensions`                         | Token extensions are only present in `spl-token-2022` tokens. Be cautious — some extensions can be used by scammers! (This does **not** apply to tokens from pump.fun, Bonk, or other trusted launchpads.) Check our [guide](/tutorials/detect_scam_tokens.md) to learn which extensions are safe.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `tradersInvolved`                         | Addresses that **actually executed the trade** (spent funds). This field is critical for copy trading and analytics. A transaction may be **signed and paid for** by one address (`txSigner`), while the **trade itself is executed** using funds from another address. In such cases, `txSigner` shows the fee-payer, but `tradersInvolved` contains the real trader. Always track accounts by `tradersInvolved`, not `txSigner`, or you may miss trades. [Visualization](https://prnt.sc/0y5d2_tMLucE)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `programsUsed`                            | Programs the action was called through, for example a router or an aggregator like Jupiter. Each event has its own list. `[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `addressLookupTables`                     | Address Lookup Tables (ALTs) are used to include more accounts than the transaction limit allows by referencing account indices within the tables. We send a list of the ALTs used.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `postBalances`                            | Shows SOL and token balances of accounts involved in the transaction. Includes: the `txSigner`, all `tradersInvolved`, and — in the case of SOL transfers — both the sender and the receiver. In the case of token transfers, the SOL balance of the account that received the tokens is **not** included.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `type`                                    | Present in certain transfer and `distributeFees` events. For transfer events, it indicates which method was used to perform the transfer, for example `token_account_closure` or `withdraw_from_nonce`. For `distributeFees` events, it indicates the type of fee claim. The value can be `holders`, `shareholders`, `creator`, `social`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `isSolana`                                | Only in transfer events. Indicates whether the `mint` represents Solana. `True` if the mint is **native SOL** or **WSOL (Wrapped SOL)**; otherwise `False`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `priorityFee`                             | Shows how much was paid to send this transaction. Minimum is 0.000005 SOL (base network fee) plus an additional tip to increase the likelihood that a validator includes the transaction.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `block`                                   | Block number in which the transaction was included. New blocks are produced every 400 ms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `timestamp`                               | Blockchain timestamp of transaction.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |


---

## Trade Api

### Buy and Sell – API

Use this to buy and sell tokens.<br />**Supported pools**

* `Pump.fun`
* `Raydium LaunchPad (including StonkFun, Bonk)`
* `Meteora LaunchPad (including Bags.fm, moonshot)`
* `PumpSwap`
* `Raydium CPMM`
* `Meteora DAMM V1`
* `Meteora DAMM V2`
* `Meteora DLMM`

#### Endpoint[​](#endpoint "Direct link to Endpoint")

`POST https://api.pumpapi.io`

* Lightning transactions⚡ (EASIER AND FASTER)
* Local transactions (No private key required)

#### ⚡ Lightning Transaction[​](#-lightning-transaction "Direct link to ⚡ Lightning Transaction")

**Lightning transaction** is a method of sending transactions where we broadcast the transaction on your behalf.<br /><!-- -->This approach allows for:

* 🚀 **Maximum transaction speed**
* 🧩 **Minimal code complexity**

By handling the transaction process internally, you don’t have to construct the transaction manually — we do it for you.

> To use this feature, simply provide a wallet `privateKey` — it’s needed to sign and broadcast the transaction on your behalf.

**🔑 Don't want to send your private key? Use `apiKey` instead (optional)**

**This step is completely optional** — it's only for users who prefer not to send their private key over the network. An `apiKey` is an AES-256 encrypted form of your wallet's private key. Generate it once below, then simply pass `apiKey` instead of `privateKey` in **any** API request — everything else stays exactly the same.

Create Wallet I want to use my own private key

* Python
* JavaScript
* Rust
* Go

```python
import requests

response = requests.post("https://wallet.pumpapi.io", json={
    # "privateKey": "base58_private_key",  # uncomment if you want to get an apiKey for your existing private key
})
print(response.json())  # {"apiKey": "...", "publicKey": "...", "privateKey": "..."}

```

```javascript
import axios from 'axios';

axios.post('https://wallet.pumpapi.io', {
  // privateKey: "base58_private_key", // uncomment if you want to get an apiKey for your existing private key
})
  .then(response => console.log(response.data)) // { apiKey, publicKey, privateKey }
  .catch(error => console.error(error));

```

```rust
use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::json;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let client = Client::new();
    let res = client.post("https://wallet.pumpapi.io")
        .json(&json!({
            // "privateKey": "base58_private_key" // uncomment if you want to get an apiKey for your existing private key
        }))
        .send()
        .await?
        .text()
        .await?;
    println!("{}", res); // {"apiKey": "...", "publicKey": "...", "privateKey": "..."}
    Ok(())
}

```

```go
package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    data := map[string]interface{}{
        // "privateKey": "base58_private_key", // uncomment if you want to get an apiKey for your existing private key
    }
    jsonData, _ := json.Marshal(data)
    resp, err := http.Post("https://wallet.pumpapi.io", "application/json", bytes.NewBuffer(jsonData))
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    var result map[string]interface{}
    json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result)
    fmt.Println(result) // apiKey, publicKey, privateKey
}

```

#### Request Body[​](#request-body "Direct link to Request Body")

| Field                                                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `privateKey`                                                                               | **Not required if `apiKey` is provided.** Private key in Base58 format.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `apiKey`                                                                                   | **Not required if `privateKey` is provided.** Encrypted alternative to `privateKey` — pass it instead if you don't want to send a raw private key. All other fields and behavior stay exactly the same. Generate one in the spoiler above.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `action`                                                                                   | `"buy"` or `"sell"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `mint`                                                                                     | Mint address of the token                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `quoteMint`                                                                                | **Optional. Not required.** Use this only when you want to limit pool selection to pools where `mint` is paired with a specific quote token. If you do not provide `quoteMint`, we automatically choose the best available pool for `mint`; the quote token of that selected pool will be spent when buying or received when selling.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `poolId`                                                                                   | **Optional. Not required.** provide this if you need to trade token from the specific pool.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `amount`                                                                                   | A number (`0.01`) or a percent of your balance (`"55%"`, `"100%"`). Percent works for both actions: **sell** — % of your tokens, **buy** — % of the quote token you pay with (USDC, tokenized stocks, etc.; not SOL). `"100%"` also closes the emptied token account and refunds its ~0.002 SOL rent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
